retrieved_lessons.rationale: That rule is about an AUDCAD richness fade that needed housing or Bank of Canada path time longer than an overnight clock, and about not flipping the same Australia-Canada cross. This ticket is a from-flat AUDNZD short at a 99.6 five-year extreme. It is Australia versus New Zealand, not Australia versus Canada, and it is opened as a multi-week swing rather than a two-to-three-day fade of the just-closed Canada cross.

That rule says stay flat after closing AUDCAD until a new Australia-versus-Canada policy, growth, inflation, or carry gap appears. This open is not a reverse of that Canada cross and does not use oil or diplomacy as a reason to own CAD. It fades Australia-New Zealand richness on a markable cross after the late-October New Zealand surprise already cheapened kiwi.
